nlte_capability.gerber_deck_ion_reach: Fe II: 58 levels, ZERO bound-bound transitions in atom.fe607a — an ionisation reservoir, not a term system. Fe I: 548 levels, 12,635 transitions.
nlte_capability.nlte_source_for_this_product: n/a — this product is on an LTE scale
nlte_capability.limit: Fe II NLTE unavailable on the Gerber deck: atom.fe607a carries 58 Fe II levels but ZERO Fe II bound-bound transitions (12,635 of 12,635 are Fe I -> Fe I), so bsyn applies departure = 1 to every Fe II line and no line list can enable it. Reported LTE. The effect is literature-negligible at solar -- Amarsi's grid gives -0.001 dex (vturb 0.75) and -0.0008 (1.50), and Lind et al. 2017 section 2.2.4 states 'For the Sun, NLTE effects on Fe II lines are insignificant' -- and our own MPIA/Bergemann Fe II deltas agree IN THE MEDIAN: +0.000 dex at the solar node, 146 of 160 grid entries inside +-0.005 -- though the tail is the three strong multiplet-42 lines 4923.932 / 4924.921 / 5169.033, all at +0.015 (max single grid entry +0.016), so 'negligible' is a median statement and not a bound (Fe I control at the same node: median +0.011, up to +0.040). A two-stage Fe atom is DEFERRED to the off-solar programme, where the Fe I/Fe II balance does the log g work (Ryan, 2026-09-03). Fe II <3D>-LTE IS available (model 5, the <3D>-mean atmosphere is ion-agnostic); model 5 == model 6 on Fe II by construction, which IS the phantom-departure check. This does NOT cover ENGINE-A: that leg reads the MPIA/Bergemann per-line grid, not this atom, and its Fe II corrections are real. RYA-1055.
nlte_capability.deferred: a two-stage Fe atom is DEFERRED to the off-solar programme, where the Fe I/Fe II balance does the log g work (Ryan, 2026-09-03)

products.opacity_note: Molecular opacity INCLUDED — OH A-X, NH, CH and CN violet, 6,223 VALD lines as Turbospectrum lists with the dominant isotopologue (RYA-1207). The band previously carried none: every molecular list iSpec ships begins at 400 nm. Measured PAIRED against a molecules-off run on the same code and pool, the lever is -0.047..-0.055 dex on Fe I and -0.276..-0.332 on Fe II, with chi2r median 81.8 -> 67.4 and control windows containing no molecular line bit-identical. RYA-1209 additionally curated out Fe I 3721.272 (systematic:K07 — gf attributed to a VALD3 reference that publishes no per-line uncertainty, no NIST accuracy class, so it never met the DEEPGRADED tier's lab-gf definition); the Fe I pool is 57 candidates and the budget clears at gf rung 3 (cited lab), 55/55 GF-LAB, RMS 0.0509 dex. RESIDUAL DEFICIT: the correction still UNDER-corrects — RYA-1204 measured synth/obs above 1 on 24 of 40 windows after it — so the band remains short of opacity by an amount not yet measured on this pool, and these values are a floor rather than a converged answer. sigma_syst is unchanged at 0.1122 because it is dominated by the 0.10 dex pseudo-continuum term, not by gf: the true continuum is never observed here. Not adopted for the headline, which rests on the VIS anchor 7.466 (RYA-161: nothing calibrated to a target).
products.annotation_reason: RYA-1208: the two near-UV Fe II `synth-1D-LTE-gerber` cells carry the band's opacity state like every other near-UV product. They were run on the post-RYA-1207 code, so molecular opacity IS included -- verified against the pool rather than assumed: this leg reads 7.422 beside its molecules-on 1D-LTE sibling at 7.402 on the same 12-line pool, where a molecules-OFF run would sit ~0.3 dex higher (RYA-1207 measured the Fe II lever at -0.276..-0.332 dex). The note is the band's, copied verbatim so every near-UV product states the same residual.

nlte_capability.nlte_source_for_this_product: n/a — this product is on an LTE scale
nlte_capability.limit: Fe II NLTE unavailable on the Gerber deck: atom.fe607a carries 58 Fe II levels but ZERO Fe II bound-bound transitions (12,635 of 12,635 are Fe I -> Fe I), so bsyn applies departure = 1 to every Fe II line and no line list can enable it. Reported LTE. The effect is literature-negligible at solar -- Amarsi's grid gives -0.001 dex (vturb 0.75) and -0.0008 (1.50), and Lind et al. 2017 section 2.2.4 states 'For the Sun, NLTE effects on Fe II lines are insignificant' -- and our own MPIA/Bergemann Fe II deltas agree IN THE MEDIAN: +0.000 dex at the solar node, 146 of 160 grid entries inside +-0.005 -- though the tail is the three strong multiplet-42 lines 4923.932 / 4924.921 / 5169.033, all at +0.015 (max single grid entry +0.016), so 'negligible' is a median statement and not a bound (Fe I control at the same node: median +0.011, up to +0.040). A two-stage Fe atom is DEFERRED to the off-solar programme, where the Fe I/Fe II balance does the log g work (Ryan, 2026-09-03). Fe II <3D>-LTE IS available (model 5, the <3D>-mean atmosphere is ion-agnostic); model 5 == model 6 on Fe II by construction, which IS the phantom-departure check. This does NOT cover ENGINE-A: that leg reads the MPIA/Bergemann per-line grid, not this atom, and its Fe II corrections are real. RYA-1055.
nlte_capability.deferred: a two-stage Fe atom is DEFERRED to the off-solar programme, where the Fe I/Fe II balance does the log g work (Ryan, 2026-09-03)

products.opacity_note: Molecular opacity INCLUDED — OH A-X, NH, CH and CN violet, 6,223 VALD lines as Turbospectrum lists with the dominant isotopologue (RYA-1207). The band previously carried none: every molecular list iSpec ships begins at 400 nm. Measured PAIRED against a molecules-off run on the same code and pool, the lever is -0.047..-0.055 dex on Fe I and -0.276..-0.332 on Fe II, with chi2r median 81.8 -> 67.4 and control windows containing no molecular line bit-identical. RYA-1209 additionally curated out Fe I 3721.272 (systematic:K07 — gf attributed to a VALD3 reference that publishes no per-line uncertainty, no NIST accuracy class, so it never met the DEEPGRADED tier's lab-gf definition); the Fe I pool is 57 candidates and the budget clears at gf rung 3 (cited lab), 55/55 GF-LAB, RMS 0.0509 dex. RESIDUAL DEFICIT: the correction still UNDER-corrects — RYA-1204 measured synth/obs above 1 on 24 of 40 windows after it — so the band remains short of opacity by an amount not yet measured on this pool, and these values are a floor rather than a converged answer. sigma_syst is unchanged at 0.1122 because it is dominated by the 0.10 dex pseudo-continuum term, not by gf: the true continuum is never observed here. Not adopted for the headline, which rests on the VIS anchor 7.466 (RYA-161: nothing calibrated to a target).
products.annotation_reason: RYA-1208: the two near-UV Fe II `synth-1D-LTE-gerber` cells carry the band's opacity state like every other near-UV product. They were run on the post-RYA-1207 code, so molecular opacity IS included -- verified against the pool rather than assumed: this leg reads 7.422 beside its molecules-on 1D-LTE sibling at 7.402 on the same 12-line pool, where a molecules-OFF run would sit ~0.3 dex higher (RYA-1207 measured the Fe II lever at -0.276..-0.332 dex). The note is the band's, copied verbatim so every near-UV product states the same residual.

Fe II <3D>-LTE IS available (model 5, the <3D>-mean atmosphere is ion-agnostic); model 5 == model 6 on Fe II by construction, which IS the phantom-departure check. This does NOT cover ENGINE-A: that leg reads the MPIA/Bergemann per-line grid, not this atom, and its Fe II corrections are real. RYA-1055.

irreducible_dispersion.note: 🔴 RYA-1191 RE-DERIVED THIS NOTE AND MOST OF IT WAS FALSE. It read 'gf-limited dispersion, IRREDUCIBLE under the current NIR line list ... KP ENGINE-A 1.315 at n=7 is the exception that proves it — CRIRES+ curated lab-gf is ~6x tighter at n=5'. That 1.315 is ONE NON-CONVERGENT FIT: line 9437.793 returned A = 10.988 on this holding and 4.539 on solar_iag — same line, same gf, 6.4 dex apart, red_chi2 246 and 152, with excluded_reason blank on both because constraint_gate asks only whether a fit was CONSTRAINED and its frac_rise_weaker is NaN. Rejected by pipeline.fit_validity, the dispersion is 0.144 at n=6 — not an exception, and INDISTINGUISHABLE from CRIRES+'s 0.138. The ~6x ratio was that one line. ⚠️ NOTE ALSO that solar_iag NIR ENGINE-A already read 0.177 here because its committed product had excluded the same line; the 7x gap between the two holdings was an exclusion difference, not a telluric one. WHAT SURVIVES, re-measured on guarded pools: the NIR many-line bars are still the widest (IAG 0.307 at n=22, KP 0.386 at n=23) against the few-line curated ones (CRIRES+ 0.138 at n=5, KP ENGINE-A 0.144 at n=6), so the dispersion still tracks gf QUALITY rather than line count and adding VALD3-grade NIR lines would still widen it. But it is NOT IRREDUCIBLE: it more than HALVED when non-convergent fits were removed (KP 1D-LTE 0.895 -> 0.386, IAG 1D-LTE 0.949 -> 0.307). ⚠️ dispersion_dex above is the PRE-GUARD value and is regenerated when the product is. Report-and-note per RYA-777.

irreducible_dispersion.note: 🔴 RYA-1191 RE-DERIVED THIS NOTE AND MOST OF IT WAS FALSE. It read 'gf-limited dispersion, IRREDUCIBLE under the current NIR line list ... KP ENGINE-A 1.315 at n=7 is the exception that proves it — CRIRES+ curated lab-gf is ~6x tighter at n=5'. That 1.315 is ONE NON-CONVERGENT FIT: line 9437.793 returned A = 10.988 on this holding and 4.539 on solar_iag — same line, same gf, 6.4 dex apart, red_chi2 246 and 152, with excluded_reason blank on both because constraint_gate asks only whether a fit was CONSTRAINED and its frac_rise_weaker is NaN. Rejected by pipeline.fit_validity, the dispersion is 0.144 at n=6 — not an exception, and INDISTINGUISHABLE from CRIRES+'s 0.138. The ~6x ratio was that one line. ⚠️ NOTE ALSO that solar_iag NIR ENGINE-A already read 0.177 here because its committed product had excluded the same line; the 7x gap between the two holdings was an exclusion difference, not a telluric one. WHAT SURVIVES, re-measured on guarded pools: the NIR many-line bars are still the widest (IAG 0.307 at n=22, KP 0.386 at n=23) against the few-line curated ones (CRIRES+ 0.138 at n=5, KP ENGINE-A 0.144 at n=6), so the dispersion still tracks gf QUALITY rather than line count and adding VALD3-grade NIR lines would still widen it. But it is NOT IRREDUCIBLE: it more than HALVED when non-convergent fits were removed (KP 1D-LTE 0.895 -> 0.386, IAG 1D-LTE 0.949 -> 0.307). ⚠️ dispersion_dex above is the PRE-GUARD value and is regenerated when the product is. Report-and-note per RYA-777.

products.opacity_note: Molecular opacity INCLUDED — OH A-X, NH, CH and CN violet, 6,223 VALD lines as Turbospectrum lists with the dominant isotopologue (RYA-1207). The band previously carried none: every molecular list iSpec ships begins at 400 nm. Measured PAIRED against a molecules-off run on the same code and pool, the lever is -0.047..-0.055 dex on Fe I and -0.276..-0.332 on Fe II, with chi2r median 81.8 -> 67.4 and control windows containing no molecular line bit-identical. RYA-1209 additionally curated out Fe I 3721.272 (systematic:K07 — gf attributed to a VALD3 reference that publishes no per-line uncertainty, no NIST accuracy class, so it never met the DEEPGRADED tier's lab-gf definition); the Fe I pool is 57 candidates and the budget clears at gf rung 3 (cited lab), 55/55 GF-LAB, RMS 0.0509 dex. RESIDUAL DEFICIT: the correction still UNDER-corrects — RYA-1204 measured synth/obs above 1 on 24 of 40 windows after it — so the band remains short of opacity by an amount not yet measured on this pool, and these values are a floor rather than a converged answer. sigma_syst is unchanged at 0.1122 because it is dominated by the 0.10 dex pseudo-continuum term, not by gf: the true continuum is never observed here. Not adopted for the headline, which rests on the VIS anchor 7.466 (RYA-161: nothing calibrated to a target).
products.annotation_reason: RYA-1208: the two near-UV Fe II `synth-1D-LTE-gerber` cells carry the band's opacity state like every other near-UV product. They were run on the post-RYA-1207 code, so molecular opacity IS included -- verified against the pool rather than assumed: this leg reads 7.422 beside its molecules-on 1D-LTE sibling at 7.402 on the same 12-line pool, where a molecules-OFF run would sit ~0.3 dex higher (RYA-1207 measured the Fe II lever at -0.276..-0.332 dex). The note is the band's, copied verbatim so every near-UV product states the same residual.

products.opacity_note: Molecular opacity INCLUDED — OH A-X, NH, CH and CN violet, 6,223 VALD lines as Turbospectrum lists with the dominant isotopologue (RYA-1207). The band previously carried none: every molecular list iSpec ships begins at 400 nm. Measured PAIRED against a molecules-off run on the same code and pool, the lever is -0.047..-0.055 dex on Fe I and -0.276..-0.332 on Fe II, with chi2r median 81.8 -> 67.4 and control windows containing no molecular line bit-identical. RYA-1209 additionally curated out Fe I 3721.272 (systematic:K07 — gf attributed to a VALD3 reference that publishes no per-line uncertainty, no NIST accuracy class, so it never met the DEEPGRADED tier's lab-gf definition); the Fe I pool is 57 candidates and the budget clears at gf rung 3 (cited lab), 55/55 GF-LAB, RMS 0.0509 dex. RESIDUAL DEFICIT: the correction still UNDER-corrects — RYA-1204 measured synth/obs above 1 on 24 of 40 windows after it — so the band remains short of opacity by an amount not yet measured on this pool, and these values are a floor rather than a converged answer. sigma_syst is unchanged at 0.1122 because it is dominated by the 0.10 dex pseudo-continuum term, not by gf: the true continuum is never observed here. Not adopted for the headline, which rests on the VIS anchor 7.466 (RYA-161: nothing calibrated to a target).
products.annotation_reason: RYA-1208: the two near-UV Fe II `synth-1D-LTE-gerber` cells carry the band's opacity state like every other near-UV product. They were run on the post-RYA-1207 code, so molecular opacity IS included -- verified against the pool rather than assumed: this leg reads 7.422 beside its molecules-on 1D-LTE sibling at 7.402 on the same 12-line pool, where a molecules-OFF run would sit ~0.3 dex higher (RYA-1207 measured the Fe II lever at -0.276..-0.332 dex). The note is the band's, copied verbatim so every near-UV product states the same residual.

products.opacity_note: Molecular opacity INCLUDED — OH A-X, NH, CH and CN violet, 6,223 VALD lines as Turbospectrum lists with the dominant isotopologue (RYA-1207). The band previously carried none: every molecular list iSpec ships begins at 400 nm. Measured PAIRED against a molecules-off run on the same code and pool, the lever is -0.047..-0.055 dex on Fe I and -0.276..-0.332 on Fe II, with chi2r median 81.8 -> 67.4 and control windows containing no molecular line bit-identical. RYA-1209 additionally curated out Fe I 3721.272 (systematic:K07 — gf attributed to a VALD3 reference that publishes no per-line uncertainty, no NIST accuracy class, so it never met the DEEPGRADED tier's lab-gf definition); the Fe I pool is 57 candidates and the budget clears at gf rung 3 (cited lab), 55/55 GF-LAB, RMS 0.0509 dex. RESIDUAL DEFICIT: the correction still UNDER-corrects — RYA-1204 measured synth/obs above 1 on 24 of 40 windows after it — so the band remains short of opacity by an amount not yet measured on this pool, and these values are a floor rather than a converged answer. sigma_syst is unchanged at 0.1122 because it is dominated by the 0.10 dex pseudo-continuum term, not by gf: the true continuum is never observed here. Not adopted for the headline, which rests on the VIS anchor 7.466 (RYA-161: nothing calibrated to a target).
products.annotation_reason: RYA-1208: the two near-UV Fe II `synth-1D-LTE-gerber` cells carry the band's opacity state like every other near-UV product. products.opacity_note: Molecular opacity INCLUDED — OH A-X, NH, CH and CN violet, 6,223 VALD lines as Turbospectrum lists with the dominant isotopologue (RYA-1207). The band previously carried none: every molecular list iSpec ships begins at 400 nm. Measured PAIRED against a molecules-off run on the same code and pool, the lever is -0.047..-0.055 dex on Fe I and -0.276..-0.332 on Fe II, with chi2r median 81.8 -> 67.4 and control windows containing no molecular line bit-identical. RESIDUAL DEFICIT: the correction still UNDER-corrects — RYA-1204 measured synth/obs above 1 on 24 of 40 windows after it — so the band remains short of opacity by an amount not yet measured on this pool, and these values are a floor rather than a converged answer. sigma_syst is unchanged at 0.1122 because it is dominated by the 0.10 dex pseudo-continuum term, not by gf: the true continuum is never observed here. Not adopted for the headline, which rests on the VIS anchor 7.466 (RYA-161: nothing calibrated to a target).
products.annotation_reason: RYA-1208: the two near-UV Fe II `synth-1D-LTE-gerber` cells carry the band's opacity state like every other near-UV product. products.opacity_note: Molecular opacity INCLUDED — OH A-X, NH, CH and CN violet, 6,223 VALD lines as Turbospectrum lists with the dominant isotopologue (RYA-1207). The band previously carried none: every molecular list iSpec ships begins at 400 nm. Measured PAIRED against a molecules-off run on the same code and pool, the lever is -0.047..-0.055 dex on Fe I and -0.276..-0.332 on Fe II, with chi2r median 81.8 -> 67.4 and control windows containing no molecular line bit-identical. RYA-1209 additionally curated out Fe I 3721.272 (systematic:K07 — gf attributed to a VALD3 reference that publishes no per-line uncertainty, no NIST accuracy class, so it never met the DEEPGRADED tier's lab-gf definition); the Fe I pool is 57 candidates and the budget clears at gf rung 3 (cited lab), 55/55 GF-LAB, RMS 0.0509 dex. RESIDUAL DEFICIT: the correction still UNDER-corrects — RYA-1204 measured synth/obs above 1 on 24 of 40 windows after it — so the band remains short of opacity by an amount not yet measured on this pool, and these values are a floor rather than a converged answer. sigma_syst is unchanged at 0.1122 because it is dominated by the 0.10 dex pseudo-continuum term, not by gf: the true continuum is never observed here. Not adopted for the headline, which rests on the VIS anchor 7.466 (RYA-161: nothing calibrated to a target).
products.annotation_reason: RYA-1208: the two near-UV Fe II `synth-1D-LTE-gerber` cells carry the band's opacity state like every other near-UV product. They were run on the post-RYA-1207 code, so molecular opacity IS included -- verified against the pool rather than assumed: this leg reads 7.422 beside its molecules-on 1D-LTE sibling at 7.402 on the same 12-line pool, where a molecules-OFF run would sit ~0.3 dex higher (RYA-1207 measured the Fe II lever at -0.276..-0.332 dex). The note is the band's, copied verbatim so every near-UV product states the same residual.

products.opacity_note: Molecular opacity INCLUDED — OH A-X, NH, CH and CN violet, 6,223 VALD lines as Turbospectrum lists with the dominant isotopologue (RYA-1207). The band previously carried none: every molecular list iSpec ships begins at 400 nm. Measured PAIRED against a molecules-off run on the same code and pool, the lever is -0.047..-0.055 dex on Fe I and -0.276..-0.332 on Fe II, with chi2r median 81.8 -> 67.4 and control windows containing no molecular line bit-identical. RYA-1209 additionally curated out Fe I 3721.272 (systematic:K07 — gf attributed to a VALD3 reference that publishes no per-line uncertainty, no NIST accuracy class, so it never met the DEEPGRADED tier's lab-gf definition); the Fe I pool is 57 candidates and the budget clears at gf rung 3 (cited lab), 55/55 GF-LAB, RMS 0.0509 dex. RESIDUAL DEFICIT: the correction still UNDER-corrects — RYA-1204 measured synth/obs above 1 on 24 of 40 windows after it — so the band remains short of opacity by an amount not yet measured on this pool, and these values are a floor rather than a converged answer. sigma_syst is unchanged at 0.1122 because it is dominated by the 0.10 dex pseudo-continuum term, not by gf: the true continuum is never observed here. Not adopted for the headline, which rests on the VIS anchor 7.466 (RYA-161: nothing calibrated to a target).
products.annotation_reason: RYA-1208: the two near-UV Fe II `synth-1D-LTE-gerber` cells carry the band's opacity state like every other near-UV product. They were run on the post-RYA-1207 code, so molecular opacity IS included -- verified against the pool rather than assumed: this leg reads 7.422 beside its molecules-on 1D-LTE sibling at 7.402 on the same 12-line pool, where a molecules-OFF run would sit ~0.3 dex higher (RYA-1207 measured the Fe II lever at -0.276..-0.332 dex). The note is the band's, copied verbatim so every near-UV product states the same residual.

products.opacity_note: Molecular opacity INCLUDED — OH A-X, NH, CH and CN violet, 6,223 VALD lines as Turbospectrum lists with the dominant isotopologue (RYA-1207). The band previously carried none: every molecular list iSpec ships begins at 400 nm. Measured PAIRED against a molecules-off run on the same code and pool, the lever is -0.047..-0.055 dex on Fe I and -0.276..-0.332 on Fe II, with chi2r median 81.8 -> 67.4 and control windows containing no molecular line bit-identical. RYA-1209 additionally curated out Fe I 3721.272 (systematic:K07 — gf attributed to a VALD3 reference that publishes no per-line uncertainty, no NIST accuracy class, so it never met the DEEPGRADED tier's lab-gf definition); the Fe I pool is 57 candidates and the budget clears at gf rung 3 (cited lab), 55/55 GF-LAB, RMS 0.0509 dex. RESIDUAL DEFICIT: the correction still UNDER-corrects — RYA-1204 measured synth/obs above 1 on 24 of 40 windows after it — so the band remains short of opacity by an amount not yet measured on this pool, and these values are a floor rather than a converged answer. sigma_syst is unchanged at 0.1122 because it is dominated by the 0.10 dex pseudo-continuum term, not by gf: the true continuum is never observed here. Not adopted for the headline, which rests on the VIS anchor 7.466 (RYA-161: nothing calibrated to a target).
products.annotation_reason: RYA-1208: the two near-UV Fe II `synth-1D-LTE-gerber` cells carry the band's opacity state like every other near-UV product. They were run on the post-RYA-1207 code, so molecular opacity IS included -- verified against the pool rather than assumed: this leg reads 7.422 beside its molecules-on 1D-LTE sibling at 7.402 on the same 12-line pool, where a molecules-OFF run would sit ~0.3 dex higher (RYA-1207 measured the Fe II lever at -0.276..-0.332 dex). The note is the band's, copied verbatim so every near-UV product states the same residual.

products.opacity_note: Molecular opacity INCLUDED — OH A-X, NH, CH and CN violet, 6,223 VALD lines as Turbospectrum lists with the dominant isotopologue (RYA-1207). The band previously carried none: every molecular list iSpec ships begins at 400 nm. Measured PAIRED against a molecules-off run on the same code and pool, the lever is -0.047..-0.055 dex on Fe I and -0.276..-0.332 on Fe II, with chi2r median 81.8 -> 67.4 and control windows containing no molecular line bit-identical. RYA-1209 additionally curated out Fe I 3721.272 (systematic:K07 — gf attributed to a VALD3 reference that publishes no per-line uncertainty, no NIST accuracy class, so it never met the DEEPGRADED tier's lab-gf definition); the Fe I pool is 57 candidates and the budget clears at gf rung 3 (cited lab), 55/55 GF-LAB, RMS 0.0509 dex. products.aggregate_collision_note: Published A is the MEDIAN of the per-line abundances (nlte_effect.json: aggregator=median). On this holding the <3D>-LTE and <3D>-NLTE medians coincide at 7.552 while their MEANS differ by +0.0267 dex and the NLTE departure moves 66 of 67 lines. products.opacity_note: Molecular opacity INCLUDED — OH A-X, NH, CH and CN violet, 6,223 VALD lines as Turbospectrum lists with the dominant isotopologue (RYA-1207). The band previously carried none: every molecular list iSpec ships begins at 400 nm. Measured PAIRED against a molecules-off run on the same code and pool, the lever is -0.047..-0.055 dex on Fe I and -0.276..-0.332 on Fe II, with chi2r median 81.8 -> 67.4 and control windows containing no molecular line bit-identical. RYA-1209 additionally curated out Fe I 3721.272 (systematic:K07 — gf attributed to a VALD3 reference that publishes no per-line uncertainty, no NIST accuracy class, so it never met the DEEPGRADED tier's lab-gf definition); the Fe I pool is 57 candidates and the budget clears at gf rung 3 (cited lab), 55/55 GF-LAB, RMS 0.0509 dex. RESIDUAL DEFICIT: the correction still UNDER-corrects — RYA-1204 measured synth/obs above 1 on 24 of 40 windows after it — so the band remains short of opacity by an amount not yet measured on this pool, and these values are a floor rather than a converged answer. sigma_syst is unchanged at 0.1122 because it is dominated by the 0.10 dex pseudo-continuum term, not by gf: the true continuum is never observed here. Not adopted for the headline, which rests on the VIS anchor 7.466 (RYA-161: nothing calibrated to a target).
products.annotation_reason: RYA-1213: the near-UV Fe I Reference Grade rows landed after the first annotation pass and reached the feed without the band's opacity caveat. Same reason as before: RYA-1207/1209 applied it by annotation to the rows that existed then, and a near-UV product that does not state its residual opacity deficit reads as a converged answer.

products.opacity_note: Molecular opacity INCLUDED — OH A-X, NH, CH and CN violet, 6,223 VALD lines as Turbospectrum lists with the dominant isotopologue (RYA-1207). The band previously carried none: every molecular list iSpec ships begins at 400 nm. Measured PAIRED against a molecules-off run on the same code and pool, the lever is -0.047..-0.055 dex on Fe I and -0.276..-0.332 on Fe II, with chi2r median 81.8 -> 67.4 and control windows containing no molecular line bit-identical. RYA-1209 additionally curated out Fe I 3721.272 (systematic:K07 — gf attributed to a VALD3 reference that publishes no per-line uncertainty, no NIST accuracy class, so it never met the DEEPGRADED tier's lab-gf definition); the Fe I pool is 57 candidates and the budget clears at gf rung 3 (cited lab), 55/55 GF-LAB, RMS 0.0509 dex. RESIDUAL DEFICIT: the correction still UNDER-corrects — RYA-1204 measured synth/obs above 1 on 24 of 40 windows after it — so the band remains short of opacity by an amount not yet measured on this pool, and these values are a floor rather than a converged answer. sigma_syst is unchanged at 0.1122 because it is dominated by the 0.10 dex pseudo-continuum term, not by gf: the true continuum is never observed here. Not adopted for the headline, which rests on the VIS anchor 7.466 (RYA-161: nothing calibrated to a target).
products.annotation_reason: RYA-1208: the two near-UV Fe II `synth-1D-LTE-gerber` cells carry the band's opacity state like every other near-UV product. They were run on the post-RYA-1207 code, so molecular opacity IS included -- verified against the pool rather than assumed: this leg reads 7.422 beside its molecules-on 1D-LTE sibling at 7.402 on the same 12-line pool, where a molecules-OFF run would sit ~0.3 dex higher (RYA-1207 measured the Fe II lever at -0.276..-0.332 dex). The note is the band's, copied verbatim so every near-UV product states the same residual.

telluric.note: no admissible fit; band NOT corrected

DETERMINE-AND-GATE (RYA-460): the optical is telluric-light, so the owed action is a red-edge disposition, NOT a molecfit run. Any line inside 6867-6884 A needs exclusion or correction; lines blueward of it are CLEAN_OUTSIDE_REGISTERED_BANDS.

blockers.why: ESO ships a GDAS tarball for PARANAL ONLY, so a per-night La Silla profile had to be pulled by hand. RYA-983 automated the NOAA ARL archive (byte-range, 10.7 MB per night rather than 599 MB), so this is unblocked but not yet run.

the NOAA ARL GDAS1 archive begins there. Under the RYA-380 no-standard-atmosphere rule those frames can never be corrected by this route — a PERMANENT gap, not a backlog item. Three of tau Ceti's 32 HARPS nights sit below it.

measure_band_ew._INSTRUMENT_HOLDINGS still contains no non-solar holding and HoldingSpec carries no star, so there is nothing to point the harness at. RYA-985 made the synthesis star-generic; the holding half is open.

caveats.note: Y/J/H close within 1.93 km/s on every frame; K2148 and K2192 rail on tau Ceti and K2148 failed on alpha Cen. The CORRECTION is unaffected (the fit is topocentric and never uses the zero-point) but an absolute RV from a K frame is not trustworthy.
rests on the acen_orbit branch assignment RYA-963 left CONTESTED: the CRIRES pair says it is inverted, RYA-384's NIRPS anchor says it is not, and both cannot be right.

nlte_capability.gerber_deck_ion_reach: Fe II: 58 levels, ZERO bound-bound transitions in atom.fe607a — an ionisation reservoir, not a term system. Fe I: 548 levels, 12,635 transitions.
nlte_capability.nlte_source_for_this_product: MPIA / Bergemann mafags-os 1D-NLTE per-line delta grid (data/nlte_grids/Fe_Bergemann_MPIA.csv) — NOT atom.fe607a. Its Fe II corrections are real and small: at the solar node the grid's Fe II deltas run -0.002 to +0.016 dex, median +0.000, with 146 of 160 entries inside +-0.005 (Fe I control at the same node: median +0.011, up to +0.040). What THIS product actually applied is recorded per line in its own *_ENGINE-A_lines.csv (nlte_delta_dex / nlte_source, RYA-880); across every live Fe II product that is -0.001 to -0.002 dex, on the lines MPIA serves
nlte_capability.limit: Fe II NLTE unavailable on the Gerber deck: atom.fe607a carries 58 Fe II levels but ZERO Fe II bound-bound transitions (12,635 of 12,635 are Fe I -> Fe I), so bsyn applies departure = 1 to every Fe II line and no line list can enable it. Reported LTE. The effect is literature-negligible at solar -- Amarsi's grid gives -0.001 dex (vturb 0.75) and -0.0008 (1.50), and Lind et al. 2017 section 2.2.4 states 'For the Sun, NLTE effects on Fe II lines are insignificant' -- and our own MPIA/Bergemann Fe II deltas agree IN THE MEDIAN: +0.000 dex at the solar node, 146 of 160 grid entries inside +-0.005 -- though the tail is the three strong multiplet-42 lines 4923.932 / 4924.921 / 5169.033, all at +0.015 (max single grid entry +0.016), so 'negligible' is a median statement and not a bound (Fe I control at the same node: median +0.011, up to +0.040). A two-stage Fe atom is DEFERRED to the off-solar programme, where the Fe I/Fe II balance does the log g work (Ryan, 2026-09-03). Fe II <3D>-LTE IS available (model 5, the <3D>-mean atmosphere is ion-agnostic); model 5 == model 6 on Fe II by construction, which IS the phantom-departure check. This does NOT cover ENGINE-A: that leg reads the MPIA/Bergemann per-line grid, not this atom, and its Fe II corrections are real. RYA-1055.
nlte_capability.deferred: a two-stage Fe atom is DEFERRED to the off-solar programme, where the Fe I/Fe II balance does the log g work (Ryan, 2026-09-03)

nlte_capability.gerber_deck_ion_reach: Fe II: 58 levels, ZERO bound-bound transitions in atom.fe607a — an ionisation reservoir, not a term system. Fe I: 548 levels, 12,635 transitions.
nlte_capability.nlte_source_for_this_product: n/a — this product is on an LTE scale
nlte_capability.limit: Fe II NLTE unavailable on the Gerber deck: atom.fe607a carries 58 Fe II levels but ZERO Fe II bound-bound transitions (12,635 of 12,635 are Fe I -> Fe I), so bsyn applies departure = 1 to every Fe II line and no line list can enable it. Reported LTE. The effect is literature-negligible at solar -- Amarsi's grid gives -0.001 dex (vturb 0.75) and -0.0008 (1.50), and Lind et al. 2017 section 2.2.4 states 'For the Sun, NLTE effects on Fe II lines are insignificant' -- and our own MPIA/Bergemann Fe II deltas agree IN THE MEDIAN: +0.000 dex at the solar node, 146 of 160 grid entries inside +-0.005 -- though the tail is the three strong multiplet-42 lines 4923.932 / 4924.921 / 5169.033, all at +0.015 (max single grid entry +0.016), so 'negligible' is a median statement and not a bound (Fe I control at the same node: median +0.011, up to +0.040). A two-stage Fe atom is DEFERRED to the off-solar programme, where the Fe I/Fe II balance does the log g work (Ryan, 2026-09-03). Fe II <3D>-LTE IS available (model 5, the <3D>-mean atmosphere is ion-agnostic); model 5 == model 6 on Fe II by construction, which IS the phantom-departure check. This does NOT cover ENGINE-A: that leg reads the MPIA/Bergemann per-line grid, not this atom, and its Fe II corrections are real. RYA-1055.
nlte_capability.deferred: a two-stage Fe atom is DEFERRED to the off-solar programme, where the Fe I/Fe II balance does the log g work (Ryan, 2026-09-03)

nlte_capability.gerber_deck_ion_reach: Fe II: 58 levels, ZERO bound-bound transitions in atom.fe607a — an ionisation reservoir, not a term system. Fe I: 548 levels, 12,635 transitions.
nlte_capability.nlte_source_for_this_product: n/a — this product is on an LTE scale
nlte_capability.limit: Fe II NLTE unavailable on the Gerber deck: atom.fe607a carries 58 Fe II levels but ZERO Fe II bound-bound transitions (12,635 of 12,635 are Fe I -> Fe I), so bsyn applies departure = 1 to every Fe II line and no line list can enable it. Reported LTE. The effect is literature-negligible at solar -- Amarsi's grid gives -0.001 dex (vturb 0.75) and -0.0008 (1.50), and Lind et al. 2017 section 2.2.4 states 'For the Sun, NLTE effects on Fe II lines are insignificant' -- and our own MPIA/Bergemann Fe II deltas agree IN THE MEDIAN: +0.000 dex at the solar node, 146 of 160 grid entries inside +-0.005 -- though the tail is the three strong multiplet-42 lines 4923.932 / 4924.921 / 5169.033, all at +0.015 (max single grid entry +0.016), so 'negligible' is a median statement and not a bound (Fe I control at the same node: median +0.011, up to +0.040). A two-stage Fe atom is DEFERRED to the off-solar programme, where the Fe I/Fe II balance does the log g work (Ryan, 2026-09-03). Fe II <3D>-LTE IS available (model 5, the <3D>-mean atmosphere is ion-agnostic); model 5 == model 6 on Fe II by construction, which IS the phantom-departure check. This does NOT cover ENGINE-A: that leg reads the MPIA/Bergemann per-line grid, not this atom, and its Fe II corrections are real. RYA-1055.
nlte_capability.deferred: a two-stage Fe atom is DEFERRED to the off-solar programme, where the Fe I/Fe II balance does the log g work (Ryan, 2026-09-03)

irreducible_dispersion.reducible_by: PARTLY laboratory gf for NIR Fe I; a LARGE PART was non-convergent fits and has already been removed (RYA-1191)
irreducible_dispersion.note: 🔴 RYA-1191 RE-DERIVED THIS NOTE AND MOST OF IT WAS FALSE. It read 'gf-limited dispersion, IRREDUCIBLE under the current NIR line list ... KP ENGINE-A 1.315 at n=7 is the exception that proves it — CRIRES+ curated lab-gf is ~6x tighter at n=5'. That 1.315 is ONE NON-CONVERGENT FIT: line 9437.793 returned A = 10.988 on this holding and 4.539 on solar_iag — same line, same gf, 6.4 dex apart, red_chi2 246 and 152, with excluded_reason blank on both because constraint_gate asks only whether a fit was CONSTRAINED and its frac_rise_weaker is NaN. Rejected by pipeline.fit_validity, the dispersion is 0.144 at n=6 — not an exception, and INDISTINGUISHABLE from CRIRES+'s 0.138. The ~6x ratio was that one line. ⚠️ NOTE ALSO that solar_iag NIR ENGINE-A already read 0.177 here because its committed product had excluded the same line; the 7x gap between the two holdings was an exclusion difference, not a telluric one. WHAT SURVIVES, re-measured on guarded pools: the NIR many-line bars are still the widest (IAG 0.307 at n=22, KP 0.386 at n=23) against the few-line curated ones (CRIRES+ 0.138 at n=5, KP ENGINE-A 0.144 at n=6), so the dispersion still tracks gf QUALITY rather than line count and adding VALD3-grade NIR lines would still widen it. But it is NOT IRREDUCIBLE: it more than HALVED when non-convergent fits were removed (KP 1D-LTE 0.895 -> 0.386, IAG 1D-LTE 0.949 -> 0.307). ⚠️ dispersion_dex above is the PRE-GUARD value and is regenerated when the product is. Report-and-note per RYA-777.
